description: This file defines the ViewEditFields class, which extends ViewAjax, and handles rendering an HTML form for editing relationship fields in the SuiteCRM module. It dynamically loads link definitions and outputs a form with input fields for each relationship field.

classes.name: ViewEditFields
classes.description: A class extending ViewAjax to generate an HTML form for editing relationship fields in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, loads link definition for the relationship, and sets class properties based on request parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs an HTML form with input fields for each relationship field, including Save and Cancel buttons.
